test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(31, 26, 155)

(18, 12, 108)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed.)
solution:
**The logic followed here is : **

**First - second number = A; A × First number = Third number. **

(31, 26, 155) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 31 - 26 = 5; 5 × 31 = 155

(18, 12, 108) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 18 - 12 = 6; 6 × 18 = 108

Similarly,

(16, 9, 114) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 16 - 9 = 7; 7 × 16 = 112 ≠ 114 → Does not follow the pattern.

(19, 15, 84) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 19 - 15 = 4; 4 × 19 = 76 ≠ 84 → Does not follow the pattern.

**(17, 9, 136) ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] **17 - 9 = 8; 8 × 17 = 136 **→ Follows the pattern

(18, 10, 148) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 18 - 10 = 8; 8 × 18 = 144 ≠ 148 → Does not follow the pattern.

Hence, **(17, 9, 136)** is the correct answer.
